title: Add release team for filters
author: jonbinney
body:
* Name of the new release team: filters
* Release repositories to add:
  * [filters](https://github.com/ros/filters)
    * [ros/rosdistro source entry](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/blob/2015deacc57af0b7a10779554666cc58994356b3/rolling/distribution.yaml#L1465)
    * [x ] There is an existing release repository which should be imported: https://github.com/ros2-gbp/filters-release
* Team members
